title: Top Laptops for Video Editing & Creators (2026)
summary: MacBooks lead most video-editing roundups, with the ROG Zephyrus as the Windows alternative that comes up most often.
method: Picks come from BestReviews, Digit, UDN's laptop review blog and two smaller testing roundups. Only models or lines named by at least two of these sources are listed. Several sources are small review blogs, so treat the details as a starting point.
assumptions: We show no prices because laptop prices change often. Sources agree that editors need plenty of RAM, fast storage and a strong GPU or chip, so check memory and storage before you buy.

products.name: Apple MacBook Pro (M5 / M5 Pro)
why: BestReviews makes the MacBook Pro with the M5 Pro chip its best of the best for photo and video editing. Digit says that if you aren't interested in a gaming laptop, the latest MacBook Pro is the first name that comes to mind, and notes the older M4 chip still edits videos well.
Smaller review roundups also place the 14-inch MacBook Pro first for editors.
pros: Works with Final Cut Pro, Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve
Long battery life for a powerful laptop
products.skip_if: You mostly cut 1080p and want to save money
products.amazon_listing: Apple 2025 MacBook Pro Laptop with Apple M5 chip with 10‑core CPU and 10‑core GPU: Built f
products.desc: A 14-inch or 16-inch MacBook Pro with an M5 or M5 Pro chip, running macOS. Storage upgrades cost extra.
products.benefit: Picture a 4K timeline with several layers playing back smoothly in Final Cut Pro, Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve. BestReviews makes the M5 Pro its best of the best for photo and video editing, and Digit says it is the first name that comes to mind if you do not want a gaming laptop. It is the most powerful pick in this guide, with long battery life for a powerful laptop. The catch: it is premium-priced and storage upgrades cost extra.

products.name: Apple MacBook Air 15-inch (M4 / M5)
why: BestReviews names the 15-inch MacBook Air with the M4 chip its pick for most people, powerful enough for general photo and video work, and also calls the M5 version best bang for the buck.
Another roundup makes the 13-inch M5 Air its editor's choice for portability but warns the 512GB base storage fills up fast for video.
cons: Less sustained power than a MacBook Pro
Base storage fills up quickly with video
products.skip_if: You edit heavy multicam or 8K projects
products.amazon_listing: Apple 2026 MacBook Air 15-inch Laptop with M5 chip: Built for AI, 15.3-inch Liquid Retina
products.desc: A 15-inch MacBook Air with an M4 or M5 chip, running macOS. It does not have the sustained power of a MacBook Pro.
products.benefit: Picture a vlogger cutting 1080p clips on a train, then finishing the edit at home. BestReviews names it its pick for most people, powerful enough for general photo and video work. It is the most portable pick in this guide, and the one sources call strong value for editing. The catch: it has less sustained power than a MacBook Pro, and the base storage fills up quickly with video.

products.name: ASUS ROG Zephyrus G14 / G15
why: UDN's laptop blog calls the ROG Zephyrus G15 a mid-range gaming laptop that is also great for 4K video editing, and notes its 90Wh battery lasts about 5 hours of regular use.
Another testing roundup picks the ROG Zephyrus G14 (2025) as the best Windows laptop for video editing.
pros: Dedicated graphics for editing and games
cons: Battery lasts only about 5 hours under regular use (UDN)
products.best_for: Editors who want Windows and a dedicated GPU, plus some gaming
products.skip_if: You edit on battery a lot
products.amazon_listing: ASUS ROG Zephyrus G14 14" 3K OLED 120Hz Gaming Laptop Copilot+ PC AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 RT
products.desc: A Windows laptop with a dedicated GPU, sold as the G14 and the G15. The G15 has a 90Wh battery.
products.benefit: Picture an editor who wants Windows, 4K editing and some gaming after work, all on one laptop. UDN calls the G15 a mid-range gaming laptop that is also great for 4K video editing, and another roundup picks the G14 (2025) as the best Windows laptop for video editing. It is the only pick here with a dedicated GPU for games as well as editing. The catch: the battery lasts only about 5 hours under regular use.

intro: Editors run out of storage before they run out of power. One roundup makes the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air its editor's choice for portability but warns that the 512GB base storage fills up fast for video. Check storage and memory first, then the chip.

verdict.line: If you are a beginner, vlogger or hobby editor, get this one: BestReviews names the 15-inch MacBook Air with the M4 chip its pick for most people. It has less sustained power than a MacBook Pro, and its base storage fills up quickly with video.

faq: What is the best laptop for video editing for most people?
The Apple MacBook Air 15-inch (M4 / M5). BestReviews names it its pick for most people, and calls the M5 version best bang for the buck.
What is the best laptop for serious editors?
The Apple MacBook Pro (M5 / M5 Pro). BestReviews makes the M5 Pro its best of the best for photo and video editing. Digit says the older M4 chip still edits videos well.
What is the best Windows laptop for video editing?
The ASUS ROG Zephyrus. Another testing roundup picks the G14 (2025) as the best Windows laptop for video editing. It lasts only about 5 hours under regular use.
Does a MacBook Air have enough storage for video?
Not on the base model. One roundup warns the 512GB base storage fills up fast for video.
